notes.title: Postpone the release date
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In recent weeks, we have added hills to the game so that some areas can be above the ground level. Unfortunately, there were unforeseen problems.  Since we spent too much time on solving these problems, we decided to postpone the launch of the game, so as not to release a raw product. We apologize for this and hope for your understanding.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647342/416e90c98af6d67d4aeeff8b0d047ad21ec157ad.png[/img]
